title: Five highest ratings
prompt: The home page shows the five highest ratings members have given. Write `solve(ratings)` so it returns `user_id`, `movie_id` and `rating` for those five rows, highest first.
rules: Sort by `rating`, highest first. A missing rating goes last.
When ratings tie, sort by `movie_id` A to Z, then by `user_id` A to Z.
Return at most five rows, with only `user_id`, `movie_id` and `rating`, in that order.
hints: `F.desc("rating")` sorts highest first, and missing values already go last that way.
`orderBy` takes several columns: the first decides, the next ones settle ties.
Sort before `limit(5)`, then `select` the three columns.
starter:
